title: About left blank: no model rewrites the template from the name alone and no picture is drawn, on WordPress, EmDash and Joomla
steps: S1: No stand and no site. From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-name-pattern="About blank" apps/tracy-web/test/brief-wordpress.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-emdash.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/brief-joomla.test.mjs
S2: Each test runs its CMS brief engine against a fake site with a business name, About left blank, a working text model and a picture model, and counts the model calls and pictures.
S3: Read the node:test summary lines (tests / pass / fail) and every failing test name.
expect: WordPress and Joomla: no line is written by a model and no picture is drawn; only the demo company's name (D9 rename) changes; the report carries the note 'About was left blank, so the template keeps its own words and pictures; only the company name was changed'.
EmDash: planMenuLabels is never called (no menu label is judged from the name) and the tool gets no picture door.
A site written in one other language with About blank still has its source edition written in that language.

selectors.seam: aboutGiven(brief) and ABOUT_BLANK_NOTE in apps/tracy-web/src/sites/brief-engines/shared.js, read by wordpress.js, emdash.js and joomla.js
selectors.door: the engines' model and picture doors (fake text and image models in the tests)

evidence: TCQR spec ABOUT-3, K6, K7, D9 on dev (cowork.tracy.site), 10/10/2026: g55-ess-wp-blank and g55-biz-emd-blank, a name and About blank, turned '@Grazia on instagram' into 'Bakery gallery', menu 'Services' into 'Baked goods', and drew bakery pictures over the demo's.
fence: Engine tests over fake sites and fake models; no live CMS or model ran.
